threads.topic: Servier EUR payment paid at spot while hedge sat unapplied

turns.text: Why was Servier invoice INV-2026-0577, EUR 89,400, paid on 6 May at spot 4.21 when hedge HD-2026-019 had 60% May EUR coverage locked at 3.73?

Confirmed from the Emirates NBD EUR account: payment executed 6-May at spot. The hedge row HD-2026-019 is flagged as the open exception in the CFO cash forecast. Counterfactual cost: (4.21 - 3.73) x 89,400 = SAR 42,912.
Was this discretion or process failure?

Process failure. The AP confirmation email (Email_2, 2-May) confirms the spot rate and never mentions the hedge — AP had no checkpoint requiring treasury confirmation before releasing EUR runs. Policy v2 assumed coordination; it wasn't system-enforced. Same root-cause family as the discount-diary lapse: single-threaded handoffs.

RD-07 approved 22-May: treasury/AP integration with hedge checkpoint, system-enforced in AP SOP v3 from 1-Jul. June exposure: the next Servier cycle is due mid-June with EUR still at 4.21 and HD-2026-019 coverage unused.

PROPOSED DECISION for Khalid's queue: apply HD-2026-019 remaining coverage to the June EUR payment run (manual treasury confirmation until SOP v3 goes live), and lift coverage toward the 80% Q4 target on the next hedge tranche. Estimated June saving if EUR holds at 4.21: ~SAR 26K on the expected EUR 55-90K cycle; the discipline precedent is worth more than the riyals.
Queued for the CEO with your framing. Tagging Sara as decision owner, evidence pack attached.
